prompts.name: event-in-person
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: compact 3D editorial illustration for a Flouvi event-creation selection card. Premium soft matte clay, clean rounded forms, subtle studio lighting, expressive yet simple readable silhouette at 96px. Brand palette STRICT: violet #743DF5, deep plum #231A33, apricot #FFD09D, mist #F3EEFF and white. A subtle open-circle motif. Square composition, one centered compact object cluster with generous transparent padding, isolated on genuinely transparent background. No text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no rectangular background, no scenery. A miniature event stage with two friendly simple attendee silhouettes and one prominent violet location pin; conveys attending an event in person.
